nodes.text: 1. Form 3 of Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers-Disclosure scheme will be enabled shortly

2. Due dates for filing of Income Tax Returns and Audit Reports for AY 2026-27 are extended in the cases of persons mentioned at Sl.No.2 in the Table below Explanation2 to Sub-section (1) of Section 139 of Income Tax Act 1961 vide Circular No.07/2026 dated 28th September,2026.
3. Form 1 under the “Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme” is now available for filing.
4. ITR-1, ITR-2, ITR-3, ITR-4, ITR-5, ITR-6 and ITR-7 for AY 2026-27 are available for filing through both online and offline utilities.
5. Filing of TDS/TCS Correction Statements pertaining to Tax Year 2026-27 has been enabled.

6. Demand Management Facilitation Centre (DFC), has been set up to guide Taxpayers on issues/grievances regarding their outstanding demands. DFC may be contacted through the e-mail id: taxdemand@cpc.incometax.gov.in or on the toll-free number - 1800 309 0131 or chargeable no. 0821-6671200.
7. Excel utilities for filing Updated return for ITR-1 to 7 for AY 2022-23 as per Finance Act, 2026 are available for filing !

Vibha Gupta founded Tax Swami with a simple belief: professional financial and legal guidance should be clear, accessible, and practical. With experience across taxation, litigation, finance, and corporate law, the approach focuses on understanding each situation thoroughly and providing clear, considered, and actionable advice.  At Tax Swami, this philosophy extends to a multidisciplinary team with expertise in taxation, accounting, legal advisory, compliance, and business consulting. By bringing these perspectives together, we help individuals and businesses navigate complex financial, legal, and regulatory matters with greater clarity and confidence.
Your Trusted Partner in Tax & Financial Consultancy
More than just numbers — we're your long-term financial partners, committed to your growth, compliance, and success.
CA Vibha Gupta, Founder of Tax Swami and Proprietor of Vibha Gupta & Co., established the firm in 2019 with a vision to provide reliable and professional consultancy services.

At Tax Swami, our team of Chartered Accountants (CA), Cost & Management Accountants (CMA), Advocates, and MBA professionals offers comprehensive solutions in taxation, accounting, financial management, and legal consulting.
Led by CA Vibha Gupta & Experts.
We combine technical excellence with practical insight to help our clients achieve sustainable success and make confident financial and legal decisions.
